description: This repo had customManagers and packageRules but never extended the org preset, so it ran on admin defaults: no graduated soak, no per-type semantic commits, no dashboard-approval gate. The repo every other repo's CI depends on was the least governed one. Its own rules below are unchanged and still win — repo config is applied after presets.

customManagers.description: The release toolchain images (built in webgrip/infrastructure, ADR 0005) are named in workflow input DEFAULTS. Renovate's workflow manager pins `uses:` refs but is blind to an image tag handed to a job via an input default, so nothing would watch the toolchain a release actually runs in. Same annotated-default pattern infrastructure uses for tool versions passed to composite actions. Only the tag is captured; the repository comes from depName.

packageRules.description: The toolchain image tag is a bare version reused as part of a composed image ref; appending an @sha256 digest would corrupt it.
